reader.boundContext: Let k be the required assignment weight, n the number of Boolean input variables, and B the bit length of the circuit and its weight specification.

inputConditions.condition: The circuit has depth t. Unbounded-fan-in AND and OR gates alternate, the output gate is AND, and the inputs are literals.

recoveryAssessments.comparison: The exclusion with a parameter-dependent prefactor also excludes the historical running time without that prefactor, under the same source conventions.

supersessions.reason: On the same explicit circuits n ≤ B. A running time n^(o(k)) B^(O(1)) is therefore at most B^(o(k)), within the full-input exclusion under the recorded source conventions.

recoveryDispositions.reason: The alternative places the sublinear exponent on the number of circuit inputs. The historical bound places it on the entire circuit encoding, which includes the gates and wires. The candidate-count exclusion does not imply the full-input exclusion or a controlled loss in its exponent.

The alternative permits a fixed polynomial in full encoding length and places the remaining exponent on the number of circuit inputs. A solver with sublinear exponent in the entire encoding length need not be bounded by that mixed clock. The source gives no such conversion under the recorded assumptions.
